World assumption: a condition or status holds only if listed under [Baseline Records], derived from [Decision Clauses], or reported in a verified update later in this dialogue.

[Baseline Records]
- [R1] Orbiter Sat-73 is registered under active default status.
- [R2] Orbiter Sat-73 belongs to Band Zenith.
- [R3] For Orbiter Sat-73, the solar shield is inactive.
- [R4] Orbiter Sat-94 passed doppler sweep.
- [R5] Orbiter Sat-61 logged clock alignment.

[Decision Clauses]
[C1] Whenever Orbiter Sat-73 emitted a carrier spike and the flux metric is at least 40, it follows that Orbiter Sat-73 enters ephemeris check.
[C2] Whenever Orbiter Sat-73 enters ephemeris check, it follows that Orbiter Sat-73 qualifies for escalation.
[C3] Whenever Orbiter Sat-73 qualifies for escalation, it follows that Orbiter Sat-73 unlocks dish override.
Override rule [C4]: Whenever Orbiter Sat-73 unlocks dish override, replace the default assignment for Orbiter Sat-73 with Link-K3.
[C5] Whenever Orbiter Sat-94 passed doppler sweep and Orbiter Sat-61 logged clock alignment, log a routine clerical memo for Orbiter Sat-94.
[C6] Whenever Orbiter Sat-61 emitted a carrier spike, it follows that Orbiter Sat-61 is placed on a watch list.
[C7] Whenever Orbiter Sat-73 enters ephemeris check, it follows that Orbiter Sat-73 receives a periodic log review.
[C8] Restricted to Band Nadir: whenever Orbiter Sat-73 emitted a carrier spike, it follows that Orbiter Sat-73 is queued for archival.

[Default Assignment] Orbiter Sat-73 is under active default status, so Orbiter Sat-73 is assigned to Link-K2 unless a decision clause establishes that Orbiter Sat-73 unlocks dish override.

Using only the baseline records and decision clauses above, determine the valid outcome for Orbiter Sat-73.
A) Link-K4
B) Link-K1
C) Link-K3
D) Link-K2
